entities.name: Prosthetic valve hemolysis
observations: New apical systolic murmur, dyspnea, severe anemia, and low haptoglobin soon after mechanical mitral valve replacement suggest paravalvular leak or prosthetic dehiscence with mechanical hemolysis.

Urgent TEE, preferably 3-D, evaluates prosthetic regurgitation, leak, dehiscence, leaflet motion, thrombus, and vegetation; transfusion at hemoglobin 7 g/dL may support but does not replace urgent diagnostic evaluation.
